Original immutable late_receipt event must bind work ID, attempt ID and lease epoch, have both status fields null, and occur at or after original pack intent.

All downstream original _physical code is AST-identical, including latest attempt, durable logical and physical receipts, request/prompt/model/hash binding, 2xx check, settled completed physical fee/no inflight, original C06 subject receipt and fingerprint fences. Output fields remain identical.

No data, receipt, phase, fee, score, checkpoint or lease is rewritten by the new proof. Only existing explicit owner resolution can act after original authority; no automatic retry and no expired checkpoint adoption is introduced.
Current uncertain work is never promoted to answered/scored by receipt presence; known physical outcome evidence serves original owner control only.
